description: Instantiate a self-contained GLSL TOP raymarcher (volumetric / signed-distance-field) — the 3D complement to create_shader_lib. Scenes: sphere_field (repeated spheres), menger (Menger-sponge fractal), tunnel (twisting tunnel). Exposes live CameraZ / Speed / StepCount / Intensity / ColorA / ColorB controls and previews the output TOP.

camera_z.description: Camera distance back from the origin (uCameraZ). Exposed as a live 'CameraZ' control.

color_a.description: Near/primary colour as hex (e.g. '#33ccff'); parsed to 0..1 RGB, exposed as 'ColorA'.

color_b.description: Far/secondary colour as hex (e.g. '#ff2266'); parsed to 0..1 RGB, exposed as 'ColorB'.

expose_controls.description: Expose live CameraZ / Speed / StepCount / Intensity / ColorA / ColorB controls.

intensity.description: Output brightness multiplier (uIntensity). Exposed as a live 'Intensity' control.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the self-contained 'raymarch_scene_<scene>' container is created inside.

resolution.description: Output resolution [width, height] of the GLSL TOP.

scene.description: Which SDF scene to ray-march: sphere_field, menger (sponge fractal), or tunnel.

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier (drives uTime). Exposed as a live 'Speed' control.

step_count.description: Raymarch iterations (uSteps); higher = more detail/cost. Exposed as 'StepCount'.

name: create_raymarch_scene
title: Create raymarch scene
